# contabo_object_storage_object (Resource)

This resource uploads a small object, such as a JSON document, into a bucket of your object storage. The provider reads the S3 keys of its API user from the Contabo API, so you do not need an S3 provider or S3 keys in your configuration.

Contabo serves public buckets through a cache. An object without a `cache_control` value can stay in that cache for a long time after you change the object, and you cannot empty the cache. Set `cache_control` on every object that a public bucket serves and that you plan to change, for example `public, max-age=60`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Publish an OpenID Connect discovery document in a public bucket.
resource "contabo_object_storage_bucket" "oidc" {
  name              = "my-cluster-oidc"
  object_storage_id = contabo_object_storage.this.id
  public_sharing    = true
}

resource "contabo_object_storage_object" "discovery" {
  object_storage_id = contabo_object_storage.this.id
  bucket            = contabo_object_storage_bucket.oidc.name
  key               = ".well-known/openid-configuration"
  content           = jsonencode({ issuer = contabo_object_storage_bucket.oidc.public_sharing_link })
  content_type      = "application/json"

  # Public buckets are served through a cache. Without this header, a changed
  # object can stay in the cache for a long time.
  cache_control = "public, max-age=60"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The name of the bucket.
- `key` (String) The key (the path) of the object inside the bucket, for example `.well-known/openid-configuration`. The key must not start with a slash.
- `object_storage_id` (String) The id of the object storage that holds the bucket.

### Optional

- `cache_control` (String) The `Cache-Control` header of the object, for example `public, max-age=60`. The cache in front of public buckets respects this value.
- `content` (String) The content of the object as text. Set either `content` or `content_base64`.
- `content_base64` (String) The content of the object, encoded with base64. Use this setting for binary content. Set either `content` or `content_base64`.
- `content_type` (String) The media type of the object, for example `application/json`. The default value is `application/octet-stream`.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) The entity tag of the object. For objects that this resource uploads, the value is the MD5 hash of the content.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `url` (String) The public address of the object. The address only works when the bucket has `public_sharing` turned on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Objects are imported by "<object_storage_id>/<bucket>/<key>". The key may contain slashes.
terraform import contabo_object_storage_object.discovery 74ff44a7-c615-423c-a770-d790236573c2/my-cluster-oidc/.well-known/openid-configuration
```
